en.answer: If the effect of <<13922>> was activated successfully during your Main Phase and was not negated, it will be applied normally during the End Phase even if <<13922>> itself is no longer on the field at that time.
en.question: During my Main Phase, I activate the effect of <<13922>> that adds a "Gravekeeper's" monster or "<<5533>>" card from my Deck to my hand during this turn's End Phase. If <<13922>> is destroyed by a card effect and leaves the field before the End Phase, will its effect be applied?
